title: Martin Reynolds confronts love’s endless question with “Why Do I?”
htmlContent: Martin Reynolds is back with a new single titled “Why Do I?”. This lively song combines the spirit of rock and soul, drawing inspiration from legends like The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, and Neil Young. Teaming up with his band, The Minor Detours, Reynolds moves away from his solo approach on his first album, creating a vibrant and exciting new sound. “Why Do I?” is a deep dive into feelings, exploring the struggle between wanting someone and the doubts that come with it. Reynolds’s powerful and relatable voice captures the complicated emotions of loving someone even when you know there might be challenges. The music has an energetic beat, filled with classic rock vibes that feel familiar and fresh. https://open.spotify.com/track/52hEARL9LgEm5yoLwp7lq7 There’s a spirited attitude in this song that embraces the ups and downs of love without getting too bogged down by sorrow. Reynolds, known for his ability to write music that resonates, offers a heartfelt expression packaged in a thrilling rock experience. “Why Do I?” showcases the joy of working together creatively and reminds us that even amidst love’s challenges, there’s always a reason to celebrate.
